description: This file contains Python functions and a handler for extracting and setting external ARM toolchain version information, including GCC, libc, kernel, GDB, and BFD versions, based on build environment variables and command outputs.

methods.name: eat_run
methods.description: Executes a command in the build environment, capturing stderr.

methods.name: eat_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the GCC compiler.

methods.name: eat_get_main_version
methods.description: Parses and extracts the main version (YYYY.MM or release) from the compiler version info.

methods.name: eat_get_gcc_version
methods.description: Extracts the x.y.z version number from the compiler version info.

methods.name: eat_get_libc_version
methods.description: Obtains the libc version from the external toolchain's ldd --version output.

methods.name: eat_get_kernel_version
methods.description: Reads the Linux kernel version from version.h in the external sys path.
